Use case: stylized-concept. National cultural heritage travel illustration in the visual style of Day of the Tentacle adventure-game backgrounds with strongly exaggerated wonky angular architecture, crooked perspective and thick dark plum ink contours, combined with sculpted cel-shaded 3D volume, soft cast shadows, ambient occlusion and visible layered depth. NOT a realistic photo. Clear foreground/middle/background separation for parallax shader presentation, atmospheric distant scenery, bold silhouettes and rich organized details. Use real recognizable landmarks from the specified country only, regionally accurate natural animals in separate appropriate habitats. No invented landmark combinations presented as a literal place: this is explicitly a national travel montage. Natural animals without clothes, anthropomorphism or silly expressions. No octopuses, tentacles, fantasy creatures, silly characters or people. No words, lettering, flags, logos, watermarks or national emblems. STRICT EVERYWHERE even tiny skyline: no mosque, minaret, Islamic religious architecture, Islamic symbols, religious crescents, Islamic inscriptions or calligraphy. Civilian background houses only. Authentic Christian churches/cathedrals, Buddhist/Hindu temples, synagogues and ancient sacred monuments ARE allowed and encouraged when significant; do not exclude permitted landmarks merely because religious. Represent listed authentic regional sites without inventing extra religious buildings. Final composition is a broad representative regional selection, never all districts or exhaustive heritage. Keep every primary landmark roof and all animal silhouettes fully inside frame, with margins. Country: Bangladesh. Palette from supplied collection: #E998C3 #E9A4D6 #B79FE9 #ECB074, supported by muted natural stone, wood and vegetation colors with purple shadows. Show these authentic landmarks in distinct regional clusters: Somapura Buddhist vihara (Naogaon); Mahasthangarh ruins (Bogura); Kantajew Hindu temple (Dinajpur); National Parliament building (Dhaka); Ahsan Manzil palace (Dhaka); Sundarbans mangroves (Khulna). Natural animals in appropriate separate habitats: Bengal tiger in Sundarbans, Ganges river dolphin. Local plants: water lily, mangrove. Small optional authentic craft/food detail: jamdani textile. Cover panorama3:1 final1500x500. Clear broad region clusters from left to right, animal foreground near lower-right and plants lower-left; ample upper breathing room, mountains and sky far behind.
CRITICAL visual priority: VERY THICK dark plum cartoon contours on every silhouette, crooked angular buildings, sculpted chunky 3D volume, broad pastel flat cel-shading, no realistic texture. Ahsan Manzil is civilian palace. Somapura stepped brick Buddhist ruins, Kantajew terracotta Hindu temple. Include only listed monuments, no extra religious buildings in tiny skyline. Wide3:1 panorama with natural tiger entirely in lower-right margin; dolphin in separate river; plants lower-left.
